generations.name: 2014 (A123 LFP pack)
generations.notes: First model year: 21.3 kWh A123 Systems lithium iron phosphate pack; optional CCS DC fast charging (50 kW class, about 80 % in 20 min), 3.3 kW onboard AC. Split from 2015-2016 because the cell chemistry and capacity change, which changes the charging curve. Confidence: medium (Wikipedia; the DC option is not dated per year) (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chevrolet_Spark_EV

generations.name: 2015-2016 (LG Chem pack)
generations.notes: GM switched to an LG Chem lithium-ion pack of about 19 kWh for 2015; EPA range unchanged at 82 mi (both regulators keep the same rating for 2014-2016). Same 3.3 kW onboard AC and optional CCS. Production ended December 2016. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chevrolet_Spark_EV
